capabilities: Import all BookXNote notes into the vault
Configure the BookXNote and Obsidian folder paths
disambiguation: One-way import only: it copies BookXNote notes into Obsidian and does not keep them in two-way sync.
extras: README is in Chinese. As of 2024-08-25 the plugin had not yet been approved for the community plugin platform, so it must be installed manually.
problem: BookXNote stores its PDF/epub/mobi reading notes in a JSON notebooks folder that Obsidian cannot read, so the notes are locked inside that app.

relations.evidence: 本插件是BookXNote的插件，可以把保存在BookXNote中的笔记一键同步到Obsidian中

summary: Imports reading notes saved in the BookXNote e-book reader app into Obsidian by reading its JSON notebook files and converting them to notes.
